title: Porsche — 40 Years Group C: Engines and gearboxes
publisher: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG
notes: Printed pages 18–19: 956 four valves, water-cooled cylinder heads and air-cooled cylinders; passages near the exhaust ports; separate circuits with one pump per bank. Porsche also describes an electron-beam-welded cylinder-head/cylinder assembly to address gasket preload losses during thermal transients. Documentary principles only: no model, drawing, photograph or dimensions imported. Do not confuse these engines with the initially air-cooled 962 IMSA.
